newsitem.title: UK: Vodafone indicated higher after Lex comment.
newsitem.headline: Vodafone indicated higher after Lex comment.

text.p: Shares in Vodafone advanced in pre-market trade on Wednesday following positive comment in the Financial Times Lex column after the company posted a 21 percent rise in profits on Tuesday.
The shares were up 8-1/2p to 262-1/2p by 0819 GMT in active trade of 2.3 million shares.

The newspaper said Vodafone's new tariff structure was encouraging people to talk for longer and its affiliated international business, which generates higher margins, had taken off more quickly than expected.
